symbols.name: smaller-call count
symbols.meaning: The total number of smaller calls that one call makes.
symbols.quote: A call splits into $s$ smaller calls, each on $1/W$ of its data, where $s$ is the total number of smaller calls and $W$ is the number of wires of the network.

symbols.name: wire count
symbols.meaning: The number of wires of the network, which is also the number of roles.
symbols.quote: A call splits into $s$ smaller calls, each on $1/W$ of its data, where $s$ is the total number of smaller calls and $W$ is the number of wires of the network.

symbols.name: label dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension of the fixed nondegenerate space $F$ that contains every label.
symbols.quote: The step it presents is $s<Wm$, where $m$ is the dimension of the space that holds all labels (the letter $m$ changes meaning here), so each level multiplies the cost per unit of data by $s/W<m$.

symbols.name: nondegenerate space
symbols.meaning: The fixed space that holds all labels, with no nonzero vector orthogonal to all of it.
symbols.quote: The recursion is set in a fixed nondegenerate space $F$ of a [Bilinear form](bilinear-form.md), a space with no nonzero vector orthogonal to all of $F$, of dimension $m$ (the letter $m$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: label
symbols.meaning: A nondegenerate subspace of $F$ attached to a vertex.
symbols.quote: Each vertex carries a label, a nondegenerate subspace $U$ of $F$: $U\cap U^\bot=\{0\}$, where $U^\bot$ is the set of vectors orthogonal to all of $U$.

symbols.name: label projection
symbols.meaning: The projection onto $U$ along $U^\bot$.
symbols.quote: Then $F=U\oplus U^\bot$, and $P_U$ denotes the projection onto $U$ along $U^\bot$.

symbols.name: padded volume
symbols.meaning: The stored volume of the array after padding, in bits.
symbols.quote: Let $V$ be the stored volume after padding, so each role stream holds $V/W$ bits.

symbols.name: edge
symbols.meaning: A segment of a wire between two consecutive vertices.
symbols.quote: An edge $\varphi$ is a segment of a wire between consecutive vertices, with tail label $U_{\rm t}$ and head label $U_{\rm h}$.

symbols.name: signed change
symbols.meaning: The difference of the dimensions of the head and tail labels of edge $\varphi$.
symbols.quote: Its signed change is $\Delta_\varphi=\dim U_{\rm h}-\dim U_{\rm t}$ (the letter $\Delta$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: source dimension sum
symbols.meaning: The sum of the dimensions of the source labels.
symbols.quote: Let $\mu$ be the sum of the source dimensions (the paper writes $N$ for $\mu$).

symbols.name: total decreasing loss
symbols.meaning: The total dimension lost along all decreasing edges.
symbols.quote: For a decreasing edge $\varphi$, let $\mathrm{loss}_\varphi=\dim U_{\rm t}-\dim U_{\rm h}>0$ be its dimension loss, and let $\mathcal L$ be the total of these losses.

symbols.name: edge dimension loss
symbols.meaning: The dimension lost on decreasing edge $\varphi$, the tail dimension minus the head dimension.
symbols.quote: For a decreasing edge $\varphi$, let $\mathrm{loss}_\varphi=\dim U_{\rm t}-\dim U_{\rm h}>0$ be its dimension loss, and let $\mathcal L$ be the total of these losses.

symbols.name: interchange time
symbols.meaning: The time to interchange two chunks of $e$ digits on a stored volume $V$.
symbols.quote: Write $\mathrm{cost}(V,e)$ for the time to interchange two chunks of $e$ digits in a fixed radix $q$ on a stored volume $V$, where $e$ is the digit count of each chunk (the letter $e$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: chunk digit count
symbols.meaning: The number of digits in each chunk being interchanged.
symbols.quote: Write $\mathrm{cost}(V,e)$ for the time to interchange two chunks of $e$ digits in a fixed radix $q$ on a stored volume $V$, where $e$ is the digit count of each chunk (the letter $e$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: radix
symbols.meaning: The fixed radix in which the digits are written.
symbols.quote: Write $\mathrm{cost}(V,e)$ for the time to interchange two chunks of $e$ digits in a fixed radix $q$ on a stored volume $V$, where $e$ is the digit count of each chunk (the letter $e$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: linear-work constant
symbols.meaning: The constant multiplying the stored volume in the linear work of one call.
symbols.quote: Linear work is $\gamma V$ for a constant $\gamma$, so

symbols.name: power-saving exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed number in $(0,1)$ that is the exponent of the bound $O(Ve^\tau)$.
symbols.quote: Choose $\tau\in(0,1)$ with $s/W<m^\tau$, which makes $\tau$ the power-saving exponent.

symbols.name: saving ratio
symbols.meaning: The ratio $(s/W)m^{-\tau}$, which is below one.
symbols.quote: Put $\sigma=(s/W)m^{-\tau}<1$.

symbols.name: one-digit cost constant
symbols.meaning: A constant such that one digit's interchange costs at most $\beta V$.
symbols.quote: Let $\beta V$ bound the cost of one digit, and let $\Xi\ge\max(\beta,\gamma/(1-\sigma))$ be a constant.

symbols.name: bound constant
symbols.meaning: A constant at least $\beta$ and at least $\gamma/(1-\sigma)$, used in the bound $\mathrm{cost}(V,m^k)\le\Xi V(m^k)^\tau$.
symbols.quote: Let $\beta V$ bound the cost of one digit, and let $\Xi\ge\max(\beta,\gamma/(1-\sigma))$ be a constant.

relations.quote: The recursion runs on the wires of the [Subset-intersection network](subset-intersection-network.md); each wire's fixed place is its role.
Rank-saving recursion reduces its calls to the [Address-field interchange](address-interchange.md), one per unit of edge rank.
The same recursion applies to a [Numerical layer](numerical-layer.md), where the parameter counts selected axes instead of digits.
Rank-saving recursion gives each smaller call one [Stream](stream.md) of volume $V/W$.
Along a wire, the signed change telescopes across each [Incidence](incidence.md) to the sink dimension minus the source dimension.
The same signed-sum identity is checked on the [Complex construction](complex-construction.md), with ratio $101/539$.
Hence the smaller calls are counted for the [Bit construction](bit-construction.md) as $s=Wm-\mu+2\mathcal L$

The recursion is set in a fixed nondegenerate space $F$ of a [Bilinear form](bilinear-form.md), a space with no nonzero vector orthogonal to all of $F$, of dimension $m$ (the letter $m$ changes meaning here).
